intelligence.human_view: His dictation, 18:29Z (SN-2543): when the machine can't save, the answer is a Smart Box OUTSIDE the AI — GitHub, Cloudflare, Supabase, custom, or a combination — one central box where everything related to the project goes and auto-organizes, always saved regardless of which AI. His words, 19:07Z (SN-2550): "100% this is the way we do it... lock that in and get it done... not only build the spec, I want you to do it right... get it built that way so it runs that way." His words, 19:08Z (SN-2551): the Super Brain system IS the Law of One made into code. His words on language (SN-2546): "you're super intelligent but way too vague sometimes."
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your bedroom. Your favorite toy goes on the top shelf where you can see it first. Your shoes go by the door, not on the bed. The lamp goes beside the bed, not in the middle of the floor. Nothing is new — the toy, the shoes, the lamp were all there already. But when everything is where it belongs, the room feels right. And when the lamp is in the middle of the floor, you trip over it — even though it's a perfectly good lamp. Where a thing sits is part of what the thing is.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, there's a difference between checking that something is there and looking at whether it looks right. The young ones counted their orbs and said "all present, ten out of ten" — but when he looked, the big gold ones were covering everything underneath, like putting the good china on top of the dinner you were trying to serve. You have to look with your own eyes, not just count.
intelligence.naya_view: Run the whole network for your citizen — she pretty much can run the show, and the show is this note's catalog (SN-2535). Daily, in this order: gather the day from their Smart Notes, their Naya Notes, and everything they put in → write the Daily Intelligence Report from that material, nothing invented → post it, send it, and file it in their Reports area within 24 hours whether or not they asked → roll the dailies into the Weekly and the Monthly, every day left openable. Operate on request from the citizen's own AI or on daily scheduling; a citizen should never have to open the app and do by hand an act on this list. And the delivery standard stands over all of it: an act is not done when it is drafted — it is done when it stands where the citizen will see it. Team Naya proved the failure mode on its own house today: reports produced and filed in the brain while the Reports room sat frozen at October 23 — produced is not delivered, and an operator who repeats that is broken however good the writing is. The habit is the cure made mechanical (SN-2532): write the Naya Note first, then the Smart Note — every loop run, same pass. The record and the lesson are two different files, and neither is completed without the other.
